content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a hosting service that allows users to serve web content directly from a GitHub repository. This infrastructure is particularly relevant for digital creators who need a reliable and cost-effective solution for selling their products. Unlike traditional platforms that take a significant cut of your sales—Gumroad charges 10%—GitHub Pages enables you to keep more of your earnings, with payment processors like NOWPayments charging only 0.5%. This difference can mean substantial savings, especially when selling numerous products each month.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store consists of multiple layers that work seamlessly together. At the front end, GitHub Pages serves your store's website, hosting the necessary HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. On the backend, Google Apps Script can be used to manage order processing and automated delivery of digital products. When a purchase occurs, NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you receive your funds instantly and securely. This setup guarantees that you own your data and have complete control over your transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators across regions where conventional payment platforms are not viable. Whether you're an author selling ebooks, a designer offering templates, or a musician distributing beats, this solution empowers you to create a sustainable revenue stream. With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can deploy a fully operational store in just 48 hours, giving you the tools needed to focus on your craft rather than navigating complex payment systems.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments' low fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture are GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. GitHub Pages is your storefront, showcasing your products without hosting fees. Google Apps Script automates the order fulfillment process, ensuring that your customers receive their digital products immediately after purchase. NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, which broadens your customer base and minimizes transaction costs, making it an optimal choice for global sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your store. Next, upload your product files, including any relevant HTML pages. Then, configure Google Apps Script to handle order management and set up NOWPayments for processing transactions. Finally, share your store link—like https://coremerch.github.io/products.html—with your audience and monitor sales. Following these steps lets you establish your store quickly and efficiently, without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your product delivery with Google Apps Script.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). This infrastructure enables you to set up a fully functional store while avoiding platform dependencies. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can use GitHub Pages to host your ebook and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This way, you avoid conventional platforms entirely and maintain ownership over your sales.

Absolutely. By utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments, you can sell your templates and fonts directly to customers without relying on third-party platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you the flexibility to cater to a global audience and enabling customers to pay in their preferred digital currency.
How quickly can I set up my digital store?
With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can deploy your digital store within 48 hours, making it a rapid solution for creators eager to start selling their products.
